name: weird
lore:
### On the Phantasmagoria of *Weird*

To cast *Weird* is to draw the very ichor of the Far Realm into the waking world. As the incantation peaks, the Weave feels oily and frigid, vibrating with a discordant shriek that only the caster truly hears. Visually, the spell manifests as a localized rupture in reality; shadows elongate into impossible geometries, and the air thickens with a violet, suffocating mist. Within this haze, victims behold not mere illusions, but the absolute personification of their own existential undoing.

Legend attributes this harrowing art to Archmage Valthun the Sleepless. It is said he spent forty nights staring into the "Void Between Stars." When he finally blinked, his first breath birthed a phantasm so potent it turned his entire tower to ash and left his apprentices frozen in eternal, silent screams. 

Beware, traveler: this magic does not merely trick the mind—it unspools the soul. To witness it is to know that the universe harbors terrors far older than light. Handle this knowledge with the gravity it demands, for the abyss gazes also.
